title: Los primeros desafíos
goal: Read a balance of the new republics' first challenges — defending sovereignty, fixing borders, repaying debts, building a civic culture — and why, despite it all, institutions slowly took shape.

items: List the four challenges new republics faced simultaneously.
Explain why the challenges were faced at the same time rather than one after another.
Describe what real progress had been made by the mid-19th century.
Explain what these early challenges ultimately became, according to the reading.
Use 'a lo largo de' and 'en última instancia' to synthesize a whole unit's argument.
